source.numerical_source_bridge: Archived harness SHA256 values match commit 39b5d16b byte-for-byte; current sparse_attn and benchmark_nfa_end_to_end.py have no diff from that commit. The new harness adds LongBench input support and explicit l2_subspace receipts. The archived full/full stable tree and new treatment tree have byte-identical sparse_attn Python sources and RULER input path; tail uses 32/32 and full uses 128/128.

accuracy_extension_gate.interpretation: negative score drops only; positive single-sample changes are disclosed but not treated as quality gains

protocol.references: tail no-skip and FlashInfer page=64 reused exactly; full/full no-skip reuses 9 archived cells and adds 3 long cells
protocol.speedup: reference time / treatment time; >1 means treatment faster
protocol.operator_measurement: nsys CUDA Graph node observed kernel time; not clean TPOT
protocol.clean_tpot: separate process without nsys or torch.profiler; complete decode including host scheduling
